_readme: Read-stage content. Lessons with open:false show as 'coming soon'. Each kana: char, romaji, hint (a memory trick), example word.
intro: Japanese uses three scripts. Hiragana (46 sounds) comes first: it spells native words and grammar. Katakana spells foreign words like コーヒー. Kanji comes later.

kana.hint: Sounds like "ah", as in "father". Picture an apple with a stick through it.
Sounds like "ee". Two strokes, like two eels side by side.
Sounds like "oh". Like あ, but with a little dash on the right.
